Title: Vanilla Chocolate Chip Cake
Ingredients:
1. 3 large eggs
2. 150 g sugar
3. 240 ml oil
4. ½ cup chocolate chips
5. 1 packet baking powder
6. 280 g self-raising flour
7. 1 pinch salt
Steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
2. Beat the eggs with the sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy.
3. Add the oil, then the self-raising flour, baking powder and salt, and mix until you get a smooth batter.
4. Fold in the chocolate chips, pour into a pan and bake for 40 minutes.
